scope: Read-only shared reverse-copy declaration and all-word arithmetic diagnosis. No compiler/link attempt or canonical/source edits.

blocker.definition: void reverse_copy_dwords(unsigned long *, const unsigned long *, int)
blocker.meaning: These are incompatible ordinary C function types and different symbols. Same physical three-dword cdecl layout alone does not provide a common source declaration. Do not use a linker alias to erase the distinction.

supported_common_view.signature: void __cdecl reverse_dword_copy(void *destination, const void *source, U32 byte_count)
supported_common_view.types: U32 = unsigned long; S32 = signed long; both must be32-bit in the pinned toolchain.
word_views: const unsigned long *source_end = (const unsigned long *)source + dword_count;
supported_common_view.meaning: Opaque interface pointers are viewed as dword buffers for this existing word-copy body. U32 formal preserves the caller raw32-bit count word; only the wrapped sum is interpreted as signed for the target SAR/guards.
supported_common_view.source_identity_limit: This is a supported common declaration hypothesis, not proof of the historical signature or TU. Original helper formal signedness is not recoverable from physical argument slots alone.
supported_common_view.symbol_policy: Use one ordinary source symbol and identical prototype in caller/header/definition. Rename the helper definition consistently or choose its existing name consistently at caller. No /ALTERNATENAME, wrapper, ordinal dispatch, alias flag or copied code.

all_word_interpretation.cpu: 43ab adds3 with32-bit LEA wraparound;43b4 SAR interprets the resultingword as signed and shifts by2.43c8/43cb use signed dword_count>7;4436/4438 use signed dword_count>0.
all_word_interpretation.why_order_matters: Unsigned addition must happen first, signed interpretation second, arithmetic shift third. Casting byte_count before a signed+3 retains signed-overflow holes. Casting after an unsigned>>2 produces a different high-bit quotient.
all_word_interpretation.producer: Compactor computes bytes=(descriptor &0x3fffffff)<<2 at4919/4922. This proves dwordalignment and permits raw count words through0xfffffffc; it does not prove count<=INT_MAX.
all_word_interpretation.cap_limit: The moved-word cap is checked after copying and cannot justify an input high-bit bound. The optional mixed budget is not a universal bound because zero disables it.

static_audit.meaning: Mathematical CPU/conditional-C interpretation agreement, not a historical compiler execution.

all_word_interpretation.implementation_gate: Unsigned-to-signed conversion for values above LONG_MAX and signed rightshift are implementation-defined C behavior. The hypothesis requires pinned VC5 to retain the32-bit word on conversion and emit arithmetic SAR. Do not mark this resolved until a fresh historical scalar boundary fixture and body comparison establish it.

pointer_domain_limit.meaning: No count high-bit or positivity assumption is used in the scalar arithmetic. However, source/target memory-access validity remains governed by actual buffer extents and overlap. Existing endpoint expressions can form out-of-object pointers for large/negative counts; the static arithmetic proof is not a proof of fully defined ISO C pointer behavior for arbitrary addresses/counts.
pointer_domain_limit.restriction: Do not add integer-address casts, wrappers, positive-only clamps or reordered endpoint declarations just to make this evidence appear stronger. Test dangerous INT boundary values only in the scalar rounding/guard fixture, not by allocating/copying giant buffers or executing original images.

bounded_family.family: shared unsigned-word ABI with signed wrapped rounding
bounded_family.prediction: One common void-pointer/U32 declaration plus cast of the unsigned wrapped sum toS32 reproduces all target scalar count interpretations and fixes C declaration compatibility. Meaningful pointer-view casts should compile away; preserve current endpoint declaration order, eight-word access order, unsigned positive group expression and scalar tail.
bounded_family.falsifier: Pinned compiler fails any boundary expected count or signed guard, emits SHR for initial rounding, narrows any physical argument word, changes pointer constness/return contract at the call, regresses frozen peer bytes/relocations, or requires a wrapper/alias/placement directive. Stop without an alternate casting grid.
